hook: Central Pacific sea-surface temperatures hit 30 degrees Celsius on October 22, 2026, marking the highest reading in modern history.

sections.voiceover: Central Pacific sea-surface temperatures hit 30 degrees Celsius on October 22, 2026, marking the highest reading in modern history.
sections.visual_cue: Satellite thermal imagery of the Pacific Ocean showing extreme heat anomalies.
sections.sfx_cue: Low ambient ocean hum with a sharp atmospheric rising tone.
b_roll: Copernicus Climate Change Service satellite surface map
Pacific Ocean surface temperature thermal capture
sections.animation_cue: Zoom in rapidly on the equatorial Pacific zone.

sections.voiceover: How extreme did these Pacific Ocean temperatures become by the end of October 2026?
sections.visual_cue: Graph overlay showing rising September and October ocean temperature data curves.
sections.sfx_cue: Subtle data ticking sound under narration.
b_roll: Oceanographic research vessel on choppy water
sections.animation_cue: Line graph drawing upwards to 29.7 degrees Celsius.

sections.voiceover: But the Niño 3.4 index, a key Pacific climate gauge, hit a record 2.88 degrees Celsius.
sections.visual_cue: Index chart highlighting the Niño3.4 region spiking past previous records.
b_roll: Bureau of Meteorology weather station radar display
sections.animation_cue: Red indicator bar flashing on the plus 2.88 index marker.

sections.voiceover: Copernicus Climate Change Service data shows sea-surface temperatures reached 29.7 degrees Celsius back in September. Australia's Bureau of Meteorology confirmed this record Niño 3.4 index for the week ending 25 October 2026.
sections.visual_cue: Wide satellite view of ocean currents shifting across the equator.
sections.animation_cue: Heat map spreading outward across the ocean surface.

sections.voiceover: This 30 degree Celsius reading remains the highest in modern observational history for the region.
sections.visual_cue: Final data callout showing the exact October 22 temperature milestone.
sections.sfx_cue: Soft resonant chime ending the sequence.
